records.detail: Policy 'agent-trust-acme-payments' paths are scoped to a single tenant/agent/identity-templated subtree. Rules: path "kv/data/signalloom/agent-trust/acme/payments/*" { capabilities = ["read"] }

Policy 'signalloom-agent-templated' paths are scoped to a single tenant/agent/identity-templated subtree. Rules: # Templated policy: each agent can only read secrets scoped to its own
# SPIFFE ID. The alias metadata is populated by the JWT auth method from
# the token's `sub` claim.
#
# Path shape: secret/data/agents/<spiffe-id>/*
# The SPIFFE ID contains slashes which OpenBao handles as nested path
# segments — this is intentional and matches the secret tree layout.
path "kv/data/agents/{{identity.entity.aliases.auth_jwt.metadata.sub}}/*" {
  capabilities = ["read", "list"]
}
Policy 'signalloom-fe-signalloom' paths are scoped to a single tenant/agent/identity-templated subtree. Rules: path "kv/data/signalloom/fe-signalloom" { capabilities = ["read"] }
